turns.doctor_question: Hello, what brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi. Well, I guess the main reason I'm here is that I've just... I've stopped caring about everything I used to look forward to. 

My fishing gear is just sitting untouched out in the garage, gathering dust. I used to spend a lot of time in my woodshop, but now even the thought of going out there just feels like a massive chore. And, uh... even when my kids try to get me to sit down and play chess with them, I'm really just going through the motions. I just don't have any interest in things right now, and I don't know why.
